data.problem: Understand the native Claude Agent SDK API (query/stream inputs, streaming events, tool protocol, sessions, MCP) to enable direct integration without Vercel AI SDK.
constraints: Use native SDK behavior, not Vercel abstractions.
Confirm event/message shapes for streaming, tool_use/tool_result, and session_id/resume.
Account for MCP integration and permissions model.

options.name: Minimal raw query probe
options.approach: Run a tiny standalone query() call (outside OpenCode) to log raw messages for a simple prompt + tool call. Compare outputs to translate-stream expectations (system/assistant/partial/tool_progress/tool_use_summary/result).
options.what_we_learn: Actual SDK message/event types and fields, session_id location, tool_use blocks, and presence of result messages.
options.risk_if_wrong: Low - no integration changes, just observational.

options.name: Direct SDK integration behind the existing translator
options.approach: Conceptually replace the Vercel wrapper with direct query() using existing translate-prompt/translate-stream and tool bridge. Validate that known events map cleanly (system/assistant/partial/tool_progress/tool_use_summary).
options.what_we_learn: Whether current translation layer fully covers native SDK streams and tool flows.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium - integration surface area may hide unhandled events like result/subtype.

options.name: Full native session and MCP configuration pass
options.approach: Model how resume/forkSession/continue, allowedTools/permissionMode, and external mcpServers would be exposed to callers. Map these options to OpenCode provider options.
options.what_we_learn: Complete parity with SDK session and MCP features and any missing abstractions in OpenCode.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium-High - broad design assumptions before observing real streams.

data.recommendation: Option 1 because it yields the fastest, lowest-risk confirmation of the native SDK event and session formats before committing to integration changes.
